title: Hush Security says the AI security problem has shifted from protecting models to governing identities as autonomous agents spread
summary: You cannot stop innovation in the name of security." Rather than treating AI agents as another application requiring credentials, Hush is extending its existing non-human identity platform into what it calls an "Identity Gateway" for AI agents.
